subject: different lty aes on different layers

messages.author: 37ffc8fdaa4a5001
messages.subject: different lty aes on different layers
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to create a plot that has both lines and errorbars. I
would like the linetype to vary by group for the lines but not for the
error bars. I can achieve this much.

I would also like the lty to vary by group in the legend. However, if
I set a constant lty for the layer that contains error bars, then the
legend also has a constant linetype. Sample code below. Suggestions?

Thanks,

Julin

###########
#demo ggplot2 question
#The basic problem is that I want lty to be mapped to a grouping
varible for some layers but not others, and I want it mapped in the
key.

library(ggplot2)

#create a mock data frame with four groups and 5 treatment "doses"
#height varies by group but not dose
data <- data.frame(height=rnorm(400,10)+rnorm(400,1,.1)*1:4,
group=rep(c("A","B","C","D"),100),
dose=rep(c(0,10,20,30,40),each=80))

#set up basic plot
p <- ggplot(data=data,aes(x=dose,y=height,colour=group,lty=group))

#add layer for error bars.
p <- p +
stat_summary(fun.data=mean_cl_normal,geom="errorbar",width=1,lty=1)

#add layer for lines
p <- p + stat_summary(fun.y=mean,geom="line")

#check plot
p # looks good but the legend is not mapping the lty

#try adding the lty mapping back
p + aes(lty=group) #does not help

messages.subject: Re: different lty aes on different layers
parts:
what makes wrong is
p <- p +stat_summary(fun.data=mean_cl_normal,geom="errorbar",width=1,lty=1)

this should be:
p <- p +stat_summary(fun.data=mean_cl_normal,geom="errorbar",width=1,lty=1,
legend=FALSE)


complete example is:

library(ggplot2)

#create a mock data frame with four groups and 5 treatment "doses"
#height varies by group but not dose
data <- data.frame(height=rnorm(400,10)+rnorm(400,1,.1)*1:4,
               group=rep(c("A","B","C","D"),100),
               dose=rep(c(0,10,20,30,40),each=80))

#check plot
p # looks good but the legend is not mapping the lty
